author: Kitsumi Kona
title: Looking for Artist + Rigger for VTuber 2.0 Model
content:
🌸 LOOKING FOR ARTIST + RIGGER FOR A POTENTIAL KITSUMI 2.0! 🌸

I’m starting to look into a fully custom 2.0 model. I put a long-term community goal on my Ko-Fi. - https://ko-fi.com/kitsumikona 
(DO NOT DM, put ref in comments pls)

💰 Tentative budget: around $2–3K total for art + rigging
Not completely fixed depending on what’s included!

I’d love:
💕 High-quality custom model art + rig
💕 Expressions/toggles
💕 Fun physics & lots of movement
💕 Potentially an alt outfit too? 👀
💕 And whatever cool ideas you guys suggest!

I absolutely LOVE https://t.co/M0W9Gjlb3j’s art style, so something with a similar kind of beautiful look would be amazing, but I’m definitely open to other styles too! 🌸Inksie is one of my oshi and I absolutely adore her and her model. 💕

Artists, riggers & VTubers — drop your recommendations/portfolios below!
I’d love to start exploring who could eventually bring Kitsumi 2.0 to life 💕

This would be a long-term goal, not something I expect to fund overnight. Just another silly little Shrine dream we can slowly work toward together 🥺
